name: Operator-maintained trusted DAT
source: operator-supplied (No-Intro, Redump, TOSEC, MAME or an in-house catalog)
license: record the license of the DAT source here
notes: One entry per known-good file. Populate the hashes from a DAT source you are licensed to use.
This template ships with zero entries on purpose: the tool never invents hashes or claims.
Add entries, then run: tools-console-agent.py verify --dat <this file> --path <files>
Entries match in match_order sequence; 'crc32+size' is the weakest fallback and is reported as such.
